outreach_text:
Hello Delectably Baked,

I'm Amala from MultiMax. We build affordable websites for local businesses. I found your Hornby cake business through Kislap and your Facebook page, along with your publicly listed business email. I did not identify a dedicated official website in the public sources I checked.

I've prepared an independent website concept for Delectably Baked, with a mobile-friendly introduction to your cakes and pastries and links to your public contact channels. It is clearly labelled as an unsolicited concept, not your official site. The cake photograph is illustrative licensed stock, not a photo of your products. Two current screenshots of the live preview are attached.

Live preview:
https://amalraj020-a11y.github.io/10am-office-work/websites/delectably-baked-christchurch/

Website source:
https://github.com/amalraj020-a11y/10am-office-work/tree/1c0206bad48ffc8d1d5993325da49baf8135f8d2/websites/delectably-baked-christchurch

Desktop screenshot:
https://amalraj020-a11y.github.io/10am-office-work/work/screenshots/delectably-baked-christchurch-desktop.png

Mobile screenshot:
https://amalraj020-a11y.github.io/10am-office-work/work/screenshots/delectably-baked-christchurch-mobile.png

If this direction would be useful, reply and we can discuss your own photos, current details and a small agreed budget. Backend or database features would be optional later work, not part of this static preview. There is no obligation. If you would prefer no further contact, just let me know and I'll respect that.

Amala
MultiMax
